name: browser-on-path
label: Chrome or Edge
description: Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge is installed and runnable.

commands.linux: apt-get update && (apt-get install -y chromium || apt-get install -y chromium-browser)

exe_data.prompt: Install Google Chrome (https://www.google.com/chrome/) on this machine.

commands.darwin: for b in "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" "$HOME/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" "/Applications/Microsoft Edge.app/Contents/MacOS/Microsoft Edge"; do [ -x "$b" ] && "$b" --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; done; exit 1
commands.linux: for b in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser microsoft-edge; do command -v "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$b" --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; done; exit 1
commands.win32: $found = @($env:ProgramFiles, ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}, $env:LOCALAPPDATA) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_ 'Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'; Join-Path $_ 'Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe' } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($found) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }
